releases.body:
1.1.13 update
- Fixed freeze on game over due to changes in the 1.1.13 update
releases.bodyZh:
1.1.13更新
- 修复了由于1.1.13更新导致的游戏结束时冻结问题

releases.body:
Bug fixes
- Fixed game forgetting about permadeath being enabled on a save when mod is updated
releases.bodyZh:
错误修复
- 修复了模组更新时游戏忘记保存文件中启用的永久死亡功能的问题

releases.body:
Allowed for dying in a certain way in the DLC without having progress wiped.
- <details><summary>DLC spoiler</summary>If the player dies for any reason in the simulation when they are dead in real life outside the simulation, their progress is not wiped</details>
releases.bodyZh:
允许在DLC中以特定方式死亡，而不会清除进度。
- <details><summary>DLC剧透</summary>如果玩家在模拟中死亡时，在模拟外现实生活中也死亡，无论任何原因，他们的进度都不会被清除</details>

releases.body:
Bug fixes
- Fixed permadeath not being enabled when clicking on New Permadeath Expedition until the player quits to the title screen and resumes
- Removed Meditate Until Next Loop prompt when permadeath is disabled
releases.bodyZh:
错误修复
- 修复了在点击“新永久死亡探险”时，直到玩家退出到标题屏幕并重新开始，永久死亡模式才会被启用的错误
- 当永久死亡模式被禁用时，移除了“冥想直至下一个循环”的提示

releases.body:
Initial release
- Ship log progress percentage
- Ship log cleared on death
- Campfire meditation
- Quit and Alt+F4 protection
